"import math

import cadquery as cq

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hard-coded parameters (all dimensions in mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
LEG_X = 120.0        # horizontal leg length along +X   (x: 0 .. 120)
LEG_Z = 80.0         # vertical leg height along +Z     (z: 0 .. 80)
WIDTH = 60.0         # common width along +Y            (y: 0 .. 60)
THK = 10.0           # leg thickness
FILLET = 15.0        # inner concave fillet radius
HOLE_DIA = 10.0      # through-hole diameter
HOLE_R = HOLE_DIA / 2.0

H_HOLE_X, H_HOLE_Y = 65.0, 30.0     # horizontal-leg hole center (axis || Z)
V_HOLE_Y, V_HOLE_Z = 30.0, 45.0     # vertical-leg hole center   (axis || X)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# L-profile sketched in the XZ plane (local u -> global X, local v -> global Z),
# extruded along the plane normal (0, -1, 0), then shifted to y in [0, 60]
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tx = THK + FILLET                              # tangent point on top of horizontal leg (u = 25)
tz = THK + FILLET                              # tangent point on inner face of vertical leg (v = 25)
am = THK + FILLET - FILLET / math.sqrt(2.0)    # fillet arc midpoint (nearest the inner corner)

solid = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)                          # outer bottom corner at origin
    .lineTo(LEG_X, 0.0)                        # bottom face of horizontal leg
    .lineTo(LEG_X, THK)                        # outer end face of horizontal leg
    .lineTo(tx, THK)                           # top face of horizontal leg -> fillet tangent
    .threePointArc((am, am), (THK, tz))        # concave R15 fillet (tangent to z=10 and x=10)
    .lineTo(THK, LEG_Z)                        # inner face of vertical leg
    .lineTo(0.0, LEG_Z)                        # top face of vertical leg
    .close()                                   # outer face of vertical leg back to origin
    .extrude(WIDTH)                            # solid spans y in [-60, 0]
    .translate((0.0, WIDTH, 0.0))              # solid spans y in [0, 60]
    .val()
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Through holes: over-extended cylinders removed by boolean cut
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
cyl_h = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(
    HOLE_R, 40.0, cq.Vector(H_HOLE_X, H_HOLE_Y, -15.0), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1)
)  # horizontal-leg hole, axis parallel to Z, centered at (x=65, y=30)

cyl_v = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(
    HOLE_R, 40.0, cq.Vector(-15.0, V_HOLE_Y, V_HOLE_Z), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0)
)  # vertical-leg hole, axis parallel to X, centered at (y=30, z=45)

part = solid.cut(cyl_h, cyl_v)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks: exactly one valid solid with positive volume, correct bbox
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solids = part.Solids()
assert len(solids) == 1, f"expected 1 solid, got {len(solids)}"
result = solids[0]
assert result.isValid(), "resulting B-Rep is not valid"
vol = result.Volume()
assert vol > 0.0

bb = result.BoundingBox()
assert abs(bb.xlen - LEG_X) < 1e-6, f"unexpected X extent {bb.xlen}"
assert abs(bb.ylen - WIDTH) < 1e-6, f"unexpected Y extent {bb.ylen}"
assert abs(bb.zlen - LEG_Z) < 1e-6, f"unexpected Z extent {bb.zlen}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export the single solid as STEP to the current working directory
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")

print(f"volume = {vol:.6f} mm^3")
print(f"bbox   = ({bb.xlen:.6f}, {bb.ylen:.6f}, {bb.zlen:.6f}) mm")
print("exported part.step")"
